content_html:
Holy Week in Peru is one of the most profound and moving religious celebrations of the year. In 2025, this ancient tradition will once again fill the streets of many cities with faith, culture and color, and among all of them, Cusco becomes one of the most special destinations to live this unique experience, we recommend the Peru Mistico Package 15D 14N – Live the Magic of Machupicchu and the Amazon, where you can also modify according to your interests.

Cusco, former capital of the Inca Empire, is not only a place full of history and impressive landscapes. During Holy Week, the city transforms into a space for reflection and encounter, where the devotion of its people mixes with its Andean identity. It is a perfect opportunity to discover not only its colonial architecture and cobbled streets, but also to connect with its living traditions.

One of the most shocking moments occurs on Holy Monday, when the procession of the Lord of Tremors, the sworn patron of Cusco. This image, of great significance for the people of Cusco, appears amidst chants, prayers and the intense aroma of incense and native flowers. It is believed that this dark Christ protected the city during the great earthquake of 1650, and since then his image has been a symbol of faith and resistance.

Throughout the week, churches and convents open their doors with special celebrations, while the markets and streets are filled with traditional products such as the famous chiriuchu, a typical dish that mixes flavors of the mountains and the coast, served especially during these dates.

In addition to the religious, Holy Week is an ideal occasion to get to know the surroundings of Cusco. You can visit the Sacred Valley, the Maras salt mines, or even take a light walk to one of the natural viewpoints where you can appreciate the beauty of the Andes at dawn. For those looking for something more adventurous, this time is also perfect to plan a visit to Machu Picchu with less influx of tourists than in high season.

If you are thinking about experiencing a different Easter in 2025, Cusco awaits you with open arms. It is a trip that combines culture, spirituality and nature, in the very heart of Peru.
